title: How to take Bai'at in this app
summary: What the Taking Bai'at screen shows, and how to send a request so the Khalifa can contact you. The app does not give bai'at itself.

blocks.p: The app has a screen called Taking Bai'at. Open it from More, then Bay'ah, or from the Taking Bai'at card on the home screen. The app does not give bai'at by itself: it shows the steps as Hazrat explained them, and it passes your request on so that a Khalifa can contact you.
At the top is a short video, Watch the steps: all the steps of Bai'at in Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A.'s own voice, about 3 minutes. Then eight illustrated cards, in this order:

steps: Look first, then give your hand
Come with tawbah and taqwa
It begins with istighfar
Give your hand (men)
Women and children
The pledge
The shaykh's du'a
After bai'at: hold the rope

blocks.p: Below them are more Shorts from the dars, and a note that the words of the istighfar and the pledge may differ a little from one silsila to another: follow what your shaykh or khalifa teaches.

steps: Tap 'Sign up and request Bai'at' (signing up is free), or sign in if you already have an account.
If the app asks, add your name in My Account to finish your account, then come back.
Choose the Shaykh or Khalifa you would like, or 'Any / whoever you suggest'.
Enter your mobile number (needed so the Khalifa can contact you) and, if you like, a short message such as the best time to call.
Tap 'Submit request'. The app says: the Khalifa will contact you, in shaa Allah.

blocks.p: You can Edit or Withdraw your request later. Your name, email and request are seen only by the Noor-ul-Hasrat admin and the Khalifa.

blocks.h: If you have already taken Bai'at

blocks.p: In My Account, tick 'I have taken Bai'at' and choose who you took it with, then save. It shows as waiting for approval until the admin confirms it. After approval, the full dars and the dhikr practices open for you, including the murid articles in this Library. If it cannot be confirmed, the app asks you to contact Alhaj Rasheed Khan (Ayub) through More, then About & Support.

blocks.q: Look first and understand, then give your hand. Otherwise regret follows.

blocks.note: The bai'at itself, and everything after it, is between you and your shaykh or khalifa. Ask them anything this screen does not answer.

by: Draft prepared from the dars transcripts, awaiting teacher approval

ru.title: Is app mein Bai'at kaise lein
ru.summary: Taking Bai'at screen par kya dikhta hai, aur request kaise bhejein taaki Khalifa aap se raabta kar sakein. App khud bai'at nahin deti.

blocks.p: App mein ek screen hai jiska naam Taking Bai'at hai. Isko More, phir Bay'ah se kholiye, ya home screen par Taking Bai'at card se. App khud se bai'at nahin deti: yeh woh steps dikhaati hai jo Hazrat ne samjhaaye, aur aapki request aage bhejti hai taaki koi Khalifa aap se raabta kar sakein.
Sab se upar ek chhota video hai, Watch the steps: Bai'at ke saare steps Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. ki apni aawaaz mein, taqreeban 3 minute. Phir aath tasweeri cards, is tarteeb se:

steps: Look first, then give your hand (pehle dekho, phir haath do)
Come with tawbah and taqwa (tauba aur taqwa ke saath aao)
It begins with istighfar (shuruaat istighfar se)
Give your hand (men) (haath do: mard)
Women and children (auratein aur bachche)
The pledge (ahad)
The shaykh's du'a (shaykh ki dua)
After bai'at: hold the rope (bai'at ke baad: rassi ko thaame raho)

blocks.p: Unke neeche dars ke aur Shorts hain, aur ek note ke istighfar aur ahad ke alfaaz ek silsile se doosre silsile mein thode alag ho sakte hain: jo aapke shaykh ya khalifa sikhaayein, usi par chaliye.

steps: 'Sign up and request Bai'at' dabaiye (sign up muft hai), ya agar account pehle se hai to sign in kijiye.
Agar app kahe to My Account mein apna naam daal kar account mukammal kijiye, phir waapas aaiye.
Jis Shaykh ya Khalifa ko aap chahte hain unko chuniye, ya 'Any / whoever you suggest'.
Apna mobile number daaliye (zaroori hai taaki Khalifa aap se raabta kar sakein) aur chahein to ek chhota sa message, jaise call karne ka behtar waqt.
'Submit request' dabaiye. App kehti hai: the Khalifa will contact you, in shaa Allah (Khalifa aap se raabta karenge, in shaa Allah).

blocks.p: Baad mein aap apni request Edit ya Withdraw kar sakte hain. Aapka naam, email aur request sirf Noor-ul-Hasrat admin aur Khalifa dekhte hain.

blocks.h: Agar aap pehle se Bai'at le chuke hain

blocks.p: My Account mein 'I have taken Bai'at' par tick kijiye aur chuniye ke kis se bai'at li, phir save kijiye. Jab tak admin tasdeeq na kare, yeh approval ke intezaar mein dikhega. Approval ke baad poora dars aur zikr ke amal aapke liye khul jaate hain, is Library ke murid wale mazameen samet. Agar tasdeeq na ho sake to app kehti hai ke More, phir About & Support ke zariye Alhaj Rasheed Khan (Ayub) se raabta kijiye.

blocks.q: Pehle dekho aur samjho, phir haath do. Warna pachtaawa hota hai.

blocks.note: Bai'at khud, aur uske baad sab kuch, aapke aur aapke shaykh ya khalifa ke darmiyaan hai. Jo baat yeh screen nahin batati woh unse poochiye.
